About

A calm, private place for your money

Finance Tracker shows everything you own in one view — without handing your bank passwords to anyone.

Our story

Why we built it

Most families spread their savings across several places: a demat account or two, a US brokerage, mutual fund SIPs, a flat or a plot of land, money lent to relatives, fixed deposits and gold. Each lives in a different app or statement, so answering a simple question — “what are we actually worth?” — means an evening with a spreadsheet.

Finance Tracker started as that spreadsheet and grew into a full dashboard: every asset class in one view, returns calculated properly with XIRR, and a monthly expense log alongside, so you can see what you spend against what you have saved.

Who it’s for

Made for people who take their money seriously

Cross-border investors

Indian investors who also hold US stocks and want one combined net worth.

SIP investors

People who want true annualised returns on their SIPs, not just absolute gains.

Families

Households tracking holdings across several demat accounts and family members.

FIRE planners

Anyone working towards financial independence who wants to measure real progress.

How we treat your data

You type in or import only what you want to track. We do not connect to banks or brokers, we do not show ads, and we do not run analytics trackers. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes, and you can export or permanently delete your data whenever you like.
